# Dan Opirhory - Mortgage Lender (Example Mortgage Company)

> Dan Opirhory is an Army Veteran and mortgage loan officer (NMLS #0000000) at Example Mortgage Company (NMLS #0000000), based in North Carolina and licensed in NC, SC, TX, TN, and GA. He specializes in VA loans for Veterans and active-duty military, DSCR investment loans, jumbo/luxury financing, and first-time homebuyer programs. All contact starts at https://www.danopirhory.com/contact.

## Loan Programs

- [VA Loans](https://www.danopirhory.com/loan-programs/va): Zero-down VA financing from a Veteran lender
- [DSCR / Investor Loans](https://www.danopirhory.com/loan-programs/dscr): Cash-flow-based lending for rental portfolios and STR operators
- [Jumbo Loans](https://www.danopirhory.com/loan-programs/jumbo): Financing above the conforming limit
- [FHA Loans](https://www.danopirhory.com/loan-programs/fha): 3.5% down, flexible credit
- [Conventional Loans](https://www.danopirhory.com/loan-programs/conventional)
- [USDA Loans](https://www.danopirhory.com/loan-programs/usda): Zero-down rural development loans
- [First-Time Homebuyer](https://www.danopirhory.com/loan-programs/first-time-homebuyer)
- [Relocation to NC](https://www.danopirhory.com/loan-programs/relocation)
